mapper.select: select * from eval_case_candidate where source_run_id=#{sourceRunId} and failure_family=#{failureFamily}
mapper.update: update eval_case_candidate set status=#{status} where id=#{candidateId}
mapper.select: select id,candidate_id as candidateId,draft_json as draftJson,sanitizer_version as sanitizerVersion,model_version as modelVersion,created_at as createdAt from eval_case_draft where candidate_id=#{candidateId} order by created_at desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into eval_case_health (case_id,case_version,baseline_reproduced,health_status,summary,updated_at) values (#{caseId},#{caseVersion},#{baselineReproduced},#{healthStatus},#{summary},#{updatedAt}) on duplicate key update case_version=values(case_version),baseline_reproduced=values(baseline_reproduced),health_status=values(health_status),summary=values(summary),updated_at=values(updated_at)
mapper.select: select id,status,sampling_policy as samplingPolicy,requested_limit as requestedLimit,sampled_count as sampledCount,analyzed_count as analyzedCount,candidate_count as candidateCount,error_count as errorCount,estimated_cost_usd as estimatedCostUsd,model_version as modelVersion,sanitizer_version as sanitizerVersion,availability_reason as availabilityReason,created_by as createdBy,created_at as createdAt,started_at as startedAt,completed_at as completedAt from eval_semantic_miner_run where id=#{runId}

select id,status,sampling_policy as samplingPolicy,requested_limit as requestedLimit,sampled_count as sampledCount,analyzed_count as analyzedCount,candidate_count as candidateCount,error_count as errorCount,estimated_cost_usd as estimatedCostUsd,model_version as modelVersion,sanitizer_version as sanitizerVersion,availability_reason as availabilityReason,created_by as createdBy,created_at as createdAt,started_at as startedAt,completed_at as completedAt from eval_semantic_miner_run order by created_at desc limit #{limit}
